thesis: Antti Ilmanen argues that the importance and difficulty of patience are essential for sustaining investment premiums, noting that no pain yields no premium. He further asserts that maintaining an edge requires continuous research and development while guarding against overfitting, even as strategies become more widely known and potentially shift from alpha to beta.
